notes:
# Orvio 0.48

- Your languages first: Home, "Recently added", Movies, Series, trending and the version list show Dutch, English and multi-language titles first. Choose your languages in Settings › Appearance › Languages; other languages stay in your library and search.
- Categories are grouped under their language (Dutch, English…), your languages first, and keep their language tag ("NL · NETFLIX").
- A new Home banner with a wide picture and the film's own logo, on phones and TVs. On TV it has Watch and More info buttons.
- A clearer filter bar for Movies and Series: Categories, Genres (with how many are chosen), Favorites, Unwatched and Clear.
- Live TV on phones: the channel you watched last is one tap away, and channel rows are larger and easier to read.
- Faster: title handling is twice as fast, trending rows appear sooner, and saving your library uses every processor core.
- Fixed: the app could run out of memory while starting with a very large library.
